fields.objection: The 255/300/345 MPa cases are assumed compressive sensitivities. The 345 MPa maker minimum is tensile; 036 found no matched finished-gauge biaxial compressive minimum. Catalog offset-yield strengths do not establish the first microscopic plastic onset; the model explicitly idealizes them as onset stresses.
fields.proposed_fix: Test the formed, etched, joined sheet in both in-plane directions and relevant stress states; establish an allowable and plastic curve.
